'''Teagan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

It was the homeworld of the [[Devon]] [[Species/Legends|species]], owners of the [[Teagan Tech Consortium]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer.<ref name="SGtD" />
